name: wrangler-spend-limit
description: Per-session spend limits for Agent Wrangler, as an installable extension

wranglerExtension.label: Spend limits
wranglerExtension.description: Set a USD spend limit on a session. Once its card's spend reaches the limit, the wrangler interrupts the model whenever it is working, until you raise or clear the limit.
wranglerExtension.author: Charlie Goldstraw
